t: What are milliamps used for? - Quora
s: Answer: Just a unit equal to 1/1000 of an ampere. One volt across 1000 ohms will give a current of 1 milliampere. It is pretty useful for circuits that use a few volts and modestly small currents.

The term milliAmp is commonly used when specifying the capacity of a battery. For example, the capacity of a mobile phone battery might be 3000 milliAmp – hours (written as 3000 mAh). This means the battery can supply 3000 mA for 1 hour or 6000 mA for 30 minutes or 1000mA for three hours etc.
